mentions.name: Coal chute masonry closure
mentions.description: This project involves properly closing up an old coal chute opening in a brick foundation with masonry, figuring out the tools and skills needed to redo the prior owners' improvised fill of cement bags.
mentions.problem: The prior owners filled in the old coal chute with bags of cement placed in the hole in the brick foundation instead of proper masonry.
mentions.source_excerpt: The prior owners filled in the old coal chute with literal bags of cement sort of artistically placed in the hole in the brick foundation. So I'm trying to figure out what masonry tools and skills I'll need to close it up proper.

evidence.value: The prior owners filled in the old coal chute with literal bags of cement sort of artistically placed in the hole in the brick foundation. So I'm trying to figure out what masonry tools and skills I'll need to close it up proper.
